notes.title: The Next Thing...
notes.notes: [p]We've got a lot to share about what's been happening with Banana Cowboy behind the scenes and we're excited to share it with y'all!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/68e5a2b7cb84530078cbbc8394f451cd5d76f7ab.png"][/img][/p][h2]Banana Cowboy: The Wild Bunch[/h2][p]We're thrilled to announce a [b]completely reimagined[/b] version of Banana Cowboy! After forming [b]Berry Ripe Games[/b] and bringing industry experience into the posse, we're excited to craft a whole new Banana Cowboy experience.[/p][p][/p][p]So what’s new?[/p][list][*][p][b]Story overhaul [/b]focusing on our space-western roots![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Designs[/b] for fan favorites, Prickly Pete and Banana Cowboy![/p][/*][*][p][b]A Whole New Cast[/b] of characters, including: Rio, a banana pepper and Banana Cowboy's former love, the Quiet, a sinister bounty-hunting chestnut sparrow, and the villainous Pepper Gang![/p][/*][*][p][b]New gameplay content[/b] designed from the ground up with brand new lasso mechanics and several unique planets![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/502a2fd58b009799615e0bd6fbac802a74a2e0b5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/9751d3ca56929bee63e841970d4d78b0e083e0f5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/90e738d0e71f07f18354073b9b6372e47eeac3b5.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h2]Get Involved![/h2][p]The positive feedback from you as a community is what spurred us to create this reimagined version of Banana Cowboy. Your support helped us realize this was something worth pursuing![/p][p]The Wild Bunch adventure is just beginning, and we're excited to share this ride with you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/c2fe06b66dd0c2e334b1813cf0c7a9709eadce25.png"][/img][/p][p][i]-- The Berry Ripe Games Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: A Berry Good Update 🍓
notes.notes:
Prepare for an epic showdown in the latest Banana Cowboy update as you take on the notorious Strawberry Mafia and bring justice to the newly discovered Strawberry Planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/8cea9e681bab40c48777cc08c00deccd8d226dd6.png[/img]

Previous versions of Banana Cowboy will be posted to our Itch.io page for any speedrunners who wish to compete against older runs. Post your own speedrun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/0f5af5401d7d7567a2cd3c7a3e0bb5c775f25d74.png[/img]

Added:
[list]
[*] New Strawberry Mafia world with a new boss fight
[*] New Shooter Strawberry Enemy
[*] More Hats and Color skins for Banana Cowboy
[*] Speedrun tracker on the level-select screen to see which levels have been completed
[*] 4 new achievements
[*] And More!
[/list]

Changes and Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] All enemies are now thrown with the same force (previously blueberry enemies were thrown with a weaker force than the orange enemy)
[*] Comic cutscenes now show the page number when played
[*] Fixed a bug where the second phase of the blender boss fight could be skipped by pressing space after punching the boss
[*] Fixed bug where the player could stand in the center of the blender blade indefinitely
[*] Fixed bug where the entirety of the Orange Level platforming could be skipped
[*] Camera now moves / rotates faster
[*] And More!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/cf55ee498e3ec14dedcb1311f15ed0d413d5fe2e.png[/img]

notes.title: New Content
notes.notes:
Howdy, y'all! Thank you to everyone who has played our game so far. 

We are currently adding new content to Banana Cowboy and patching minor issues that players have reported to improve the player experience. To find out when this patch is released, make sure to follow us on social media!
